title: International Olympic Committee consensus statement: harassment and abuse (non-accidental violence) in sport
publisher: International Olympic Committee / British Journal of Sports Medicine
claims: The statement defines harassment and abuse in sport as non-accidental violence, covering psychological, physical and sexual forms as well as neglect.
Athletes of all ages and types can be affected; elite, disabled, child and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender athletes are identified as at particular risk.
The consensus sets out prevention and response duties for sports organisations at the organisational level.
